townRating.rationale: Zero stars is retained. The in-boundary visitor offer consists of one compact community museum, a small memorial group and useful food stops. The strongest advertised nearby draws, Polkemmet Country Park and the Scottish Owl Centre, lie west of the NRS locality and were not used to raise the town rating.

boundaryRule: The official NRS 2022 Whitburn locality is preserved unchanged and used as the active visitor boundary. Every public planner marker is inside it. Nearby country-park, woodland, motorway and East Whitburn places are excluded.

attractions.name: Whitburn Community Museum and historic Burgh Halls

excluded.name: Polkemmet Country Park and the Scottish Owl Centre
excluded.reason: Visit West Lothian describes Polkemmet as immediately west of Whitburn; it falls outside the active NRS locality and does not count towards the town planner or rating.

excluded.name: Whitrigg Community Woodland and East Whitburn
excluded.reason: Outside the active Whitburn locality and retained as wider-area context only.

excluded.name: Proposed 2015-17 Whitburn heritage trail
excluded.reason: The council placemaking material describes a proposed trail rather than a currently published, followable visitor route, so the Trails category is left empty.

excluded.name: Generic picnic tables, benches and unverified parking
excluded.reason: Not published without a defensible named location and public-access details. Customer-only, motorway and residential parking are excluded.
